title: MZ [SOLVED] Set Movement Route: Reset to the First Frame

posts.author: Sarena
posts.body:
I'm working on some longer animations for my game, so I'm trying to switch between multiple charsets and different frames. The issue I'm running into is that when I switch from 1 charset to another (or from 1 direction to another), it continues from the frame the previous charset left off on, making it randomly display frames out of order. For example, if the first animation stopped on frame 2, then it would continue the next on frame 3 instead of restarting on frame 1.
I used
this tutorial
and
this forum thread
for troubleshooting so far, but I haven't had any luck, even with the additional script call. I realize those are for MV, so I'm wondering if something changed in MZ that might be causing it to not function the same way. I referred to the
Script call sheet
, and it seems to say it's applicable to both MV and MZ, though.
